email.subject: Stride Fitness: a couple quick site fixes
email.body:
Hi Elena,

I took a look at Stride Fitness's site. Two things are likely costing you members: it's not set up well for mobile, which is probably where most people search for a gym near them, and there's no way to book a class or trial session online, so interested people have to call or email instead of just signing up. The site also has no reviews showing, which matters when someone's comparing gyms.

I run Northlight Web, a one-person shop that fixes this kind of thing for a flat fee. Happy to do a free 10-minute walkthrough showing exactly what I'd change, no obligation.

Worth a quick look?

Alex
